overrides.why: The King's army grows with every refusal at every seat (about 104 cubes at 4 players); colonies are defended by about 5, so 5% survive and the loyalist wins 87%
overrides.table: Each King's army cube attacks with 1 ⚔️, not 2. / Каждый кубик армии короля атакует с силой 1 ⚔️, а не 2.

overrides.why: Refusing is free in bells and feeds the race to 15: refusals give 9 of 15 bells and end games early
overrides.table: Refusing the tax adds cubes to the King's army but gives no bell. / Отказ от налога добавляет кубики в армию короля, но не даёт колокола.

overrides.why: Each refusal adds 2 cubes to a pool shared by all patriots, so refusing is cheap for the refuser and costly for the others (H2)
overrides.table: Refusing the tax adds 1 cube to the King's army, not 2 (solo unchanged). / Отказ от налога добавляет в армию короля 1 кубик, а не 2 (соло без изменений).
